title: Microbial degradation of bioplastic (PHBV) is limited by nutrient availability at high microplastic loadings
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00311J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Michaela K. Reay, Martine Graf, Lucy M. Greenfield, Rafael Bargiela, Charles Onyije, Charlotte E. M. Lloyd, Ian D. Bull, Richard P. Evershed, Peter N. Golyshin, David R. Chadwick, Davey L. Jones
Degradation of PHBV in soil, quantified with pyrolysis GC-MS, was nutrient limited at increasing microplastic concentrations. Hydrophobicity increased while plant and soil microbial biomass decreased at higher soil microplastic concentrations.
